title: dev.qory.run.step_exited
description: A step of the run ended. One per step, after the step's dev.qory.run.step_started and after every dev.qory.run.log of the step.

step.description: The number of the step in the run, from 1: the step of its dev.qory.run.step_started.

state.description: How the step ended, with the values of dev.qory.run.exited's state. succeeded: the step ended well; failed: it ended badly; cancelled: it was stopped before it ended.

exit_code.description: The exit status of the step's process, as exit_code of dev.qory.run.exited is: -1 when no process exit status exists, such as for a step that runs no process.

duration_ms.description: Milliseconds from the step's dev.qory.run.step_started to its end.
